equivalence.detail: Only the FINAL selected set is scored: tap order is irrelevant, and a cell that was tapped and then de-selected does not count as a false alarm (it is logged as a revision instead).

answer.scoringRule: hits = |selected ∩ targets|; misses = |targets \ selected|; falseAlarms = |selected \ targets|; score = hits/nTargets penalised by falseAlarms/nNonTargetCells; sensitivity from the same counts.

metricSpec.M-PATH: count of primitive actions in response.actions (select/deselect/done) = scan-strategy signature length
metricSpec.M-EFF: nTargets / max(response.cost.actual, nTargets), where cost.actual = total select+deselect taps
metricSpec.M-PLANFUL: 0.5*min(1, response.firstActionLatencyMs / content.metricParams.planWindowMs) + 0.5*(1 - revisitRate); revisitRate = deselects / max(1, taps)
metricSpec.M-EXPLORE: distinct grid cells touched by any tap / total grid cells
metricSpec.note: M-EFF is server-derived: the renderer never receives nTargets, so it emits response.cost.actual and the server divides. Accuracy metrics (M-ACC, M-DPRIME, M-FALSEALARM) are server-only by construction.
